name: Cosigning A Loan
overview: Scripture warns believers about the serious risks involved in cosigning loans or becoming surety for others. Proverbs cautions that striking hands with a stranger or friend can lead to personal harm and financial bondage, as the borrower becomes servant to the lender. The wise avoid becoming sureties for debts, recognizing that such commitments can bring sorrow and entanglement. Instead, the righteous are called to show mercy and generosity without compromising their own integrity or stability.
